integrity: All-rank proof uses exact symbolic arguments; finite-field enumeration corroborates ranks 4 through 7 without replacing the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced geometric singular locus and specified tangent cones are classified, not the Jacobian scheme or resolutions. Possible unindexed equivalent results are an originality risk.
title: Characteristic-two singularity trichotomy for elementary symmetric cubic hypersurfaces
